summary: Frontend-only validation of nested combined-period feature on /notes → Master Digital Marketing 2026 → Promotion 2026-2027 → 'Période combinée'. ALL primary acceptance criteria pass. (1) CreateCombinedPeriodModal (data-testid='combined-period-modal') now lists 3 source periods: 'Semestre 1' (semestre), 'BTS Blanc' (bts_blanc), and 'Bulletin bts' (combined) — the latter is a composite that was previously filtered out. (2) The amber 'Combinée' badge (Badge variant=secondary, bg-amber-100/text-amber-800/border-amber-200) is rendered ONLY on 'Bulletin bts' row, exactly as expected; verified count==1 across all rows. (3) The explanatory label reads VERBATIM: 'Cochez les périodes à empiler dans le bulletin combiné. Les périodes simples ET combinées sont acceptées (ex: combiner S1+S2 avec un BTS Blanc, ou deux bulletins combinés entre eux).' — matches the new copy in CreateCombinedPeriodModal.tsx:188. (4) Successfully selected Semestre 1 + Bulletin bts (composite), filled name='TEST_Annuel_S1_Bulletinbts', dates 2026-04-01 → 2027-04-30, submit became enabled and POST succeeded — toast 'Période combinée créée' displayed; the new period chip 'TEST_Annuel_S1_Bulletinbts' appears in the périodes list immediately after creation, confirming DB persistence (no CHECK-constraint violation on nested combined). (5) Self-reference exclusion is implemented in code (CreateCombinedPeriodModal.tsx:88-94: `availablePeriods.filter(p => p.id !== editingPeriod?.id)`) — verified via code review (could not exercise the edit-mode UI path because no inline edit-pencil affordance was visible on chips, but the filter is unconditional and identical to the well-tested non-editing path). (6) getCombinedLeafSourcePeriods (combinedPeriodService.ts:131-152) implements DFS with a `visited` Set (cycle prevention) and `seenIds` Set (dedupe), and is correctly imported/used in TranscriptsPanel.tsx:43, 202. No runtime error / no stack overflow / no infinite recursion observed in the console during modal open + create + tab switch. PRE-EXISTING unrelated console errors (Supabase Edge Function compute-bulletin CORS+404+400, useNotifications fetch failures, X-Frame-Options meta warning) are carried over from iter 55-58, NOT regressions of this iteration.
action_items: NONE BLOCKING. The nested-combined-period feature is correctly wired end-to-end on the modal: composite sources are now selectable, badge 'Combinée' is visible, copy is updated, creation succeeds in DB, recursive leaf-resolution function exists with cycle protection. ✓
OPTIONAL: clean up the TEST_Annuel_S1_Bulletinbts seed period created during this run if it pollutes demo data — delete via SQL or admin UI when convenient.

PRE-EXISTING (carried from iter 55-58): Supabase Edge Function compute-bulletin returns CORS/404/400 — client-side fallback works so no user-facing regression, but worth fixing for performance / server-side computation.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateCombinedPeriodModal.tsx:88-94 — `eligible` correctly filters self-reference only (`p.id !== editingPeriod?.id`), allowing all composite sources. Sort by order_index preserves natural display order. Clean and minimal change. ✓

CreateCombinedPeriodModal.tsx:218-220 — 'Combinée' Badge is conditionally rendered via `(p as any).is_composite === true`. The cast is acceptable here since EvaluationPeriod typing in services/gradesService.ts may not yet expose is_composite. Consider extending the type to remove the cast. Non-blocking.

combinedPeriodService.ts:131-152 — getCombinedLeafSourcePeriods uses `visited: Set<string>` keyed on periodId to guard against cycles AND `seenIds: Set<string>` to dedupe leaf occurrences (e.g. if the same leaf is reachable through two branches). DFS order preserved via Array.push. Correct implementation; matches the task spec. ✓

combinedPeriodService.ts:139 — calls getCombinedSourcePeriods (RPC with fallback). If RPC fails AND the row's combined_period_ids is null, the function silently returns [] for that node — which is the correct termination condition. ✓

TranscriptsPanel.tsx:200-204 — the React-Query hook for combined-source-periods now correctly uses the recursive resolver, only enabled when isCombinedPeriod. Cache key is per-periodId, so switching periods triggers a fresh resolution. ✓

DB constraint — confirmed empirically: inserting a 'combined' period whose combined_period_ids contains a composite period_id is allowed (no CHECK violation, INSERT returned 200, toast 'Période combinée créée'). ✓

Minor: the modal does not display a max-recursion-depth safeguard server-side. The client-side `visited` Set prevents infinite loops, but if a future migration accidentally allows DB-level cycles, server-side aggregation/RPC should also guard against it. Non-blocking for current scope.

Minor UX: when a composite period is selected as a source, the modal could optionally display a small inline expansion preview (e.g. 'Bulletin bts → résoudra vers: Semestre 1, BTS Blanc') to help admins understand what leaves will appear. Nice-to-have, not required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 7 testable acceptance criteria: modal opens ✓, 3 periods listed including composite ✓, 'Combinée' amber badge on composite only ✓, updated label text exact match ✓, selection of simple+composite + submit succeeds (toast + DB persistence) ✓, no runtime/recursion error in console ✓, self-reference filter present in code ✓ (could not exercise the edit-mode UI since no edit affordance visible)
